stations.name: Evidence and plan desk
stations.permitted_scope: Read metadata, approved plans and service receipts
stations.required_evidence: Source coverage, distinct evidence types and null unresolved inputs

stations.name: Supported carrier staging
stations.permitted_scope: Identify supported carriers and inspect qualified receipt labels
stations.boundary: No raw resin, no unsupported suspended specimen
stations.required_evidence: Accepted custody, carrier occupancy and safe access

stations.name: Closed fabrication and QA service
stations.permitted_scope: Exchange specification identity and review qualified outputs
stations.boundary: No printing, curing, finishing or operational settings
stations.required_evidence: QA release including material and geometry qualification

stations.name: Closed acoustic service
stations.permitted_scope: Review array assignment, qualification and measured event records
stations.boundary: No drive, pressure, exposure or wiring commands
stations.required_evidence: Current characterization, guarded enclosure and observed safe state

stations.name: Closed torsion and optical service
stations.permitted_scope: Review mount, optical tracking and metrology receipts
stations.boundary: No live beam alignment, suspended-object handling or direct actuation
stations.required_evidence: Support/lease status, valid transforms and safe-to-access receipt

stations.name: Closed source-motion service
stations.permitted_scope: Review plan identity and actual pose/time records
stations.required_evidence: Pose trace, observed stop and handoff status

stations.name: Evidence analysis desk
stations.permitted_scope: Review measurement lineage, uncertainty and completeness
stations.boundary: No physical simulation or source code execution
stations.required_evidence: Analysis references actual raw records; numerical source evidence separately typed

stations.name: Return and quarantine station
stations.boundary: No automatic disposal, cleaning or unqualified unloading
stations.required_evidence: Closed specimen accounting and retained failed-attempt archive

release_requires: raw and failed attempt records sealed

receipt_policy.on_unknown_or_missing: HOLD_QUALIFICATION; retain service custody and obtain authoritative status without blind duplicate requests

invalidation_events: array element replacement or geometry change
